categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen King Brother Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in integrated product design (IPD), integrated product manufacturing (IPM), printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing, electronic engineering services, digital transformation services, and innovation ecosystem services. The company focuses on electronic product R&D, hardware innovation, and provides one-stop services including electronic product solution design, BOM engineering, and reliability testing. It also offers EMS (electronics manufacturing services) and supports digital and innovation-driven transformation for clients.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as integrated product design and manufacturing (IPDM), surface mount technology (SMT), high-density interconnection (HDI) PCB technology, rigid-flex PCB, and high-frequency PCB manufacturing. It has developed proprietary EDA software tools (KBEDA series) for PCB design and manufacturing optimization. The production methods emphasize flexible manufacturing for small batch, multi-variety orders with rapid delivery, supported by digital platforms and AI-driven engineering automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: King Brother serves a broad range of customers including electronic product developers, specialized and innovative enterprises, and industries such as AI, IoT, automotive electronics, industrial control, medical devices, power systems, new energy, military, consumer electronics, and research institutions. The company has established relationships with nearly 20,000 global customers, focusing on R&D-driven clients requiring customized, high-reliability electronic solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Huizhou, Xi'an, and other cities including Beijing, Hangzhou, Chengdu, and Tianjin. It has expanded its innovation and digital services internationally with subsidiaries and offices in Singapore, Malaysia, and the United States (Silicon Valley). The company targets domestic and international markets, with a growing focus on Southeast Asia and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: King Brother operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electronics supply chain, focusing on integrated design, manufacturing, and assembly of PCBs and electronic products. It provides upstream engineering and design services and downstream EMS and digital transformation services, positioning itself as a comprehensive hardware innovation and manufacturing service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation, digital transformation, and ecosystem collaboration. Strategic R&D focuses include AI integration, high-speed and high-density PCB technologies, flexible manufacturing, industrial internet platforms, and innovation service ecosystems. It invests in developing new materials, advanced packaging, embedded chip PCB, and AIoT hardware platforms, while expanding digital platforms in partnership with Huawei Cloud to enable smart manufacturing and product lifecycle management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of PCBs, electronic manufacturing services (EMS), electronic design services, and innovation platform services. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and digital transformation service fees. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to customers, supplemented by trade sales and online platforms for smaller clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: King Brother is positioned as a specialized and innovative leader in the Chinese PCB and electronic manufacturing industry, ranked 62nd among domestic PCB companies. It competes with other PCB manufacturers and EMS providers, leveraging its integrated design-to-manufacturing capabilities, flexible production, and digital innovation services to differentiate itself. The company holds multiple national and provincial high-tech certifications and patents, enhancing its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 682.7 million, a 7.39% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 39 million, slightly down by 1.45%. It maintains total assets of around RMB 883 million and equity of RMB 686 million. The company has shown steady revenue growth driven by AI, IoT, and new energy sectors, while investing heavily in R&D and digital transformation to sustain long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: King Brother emphasizes a one-stop integrated design and manufacturing service model that accelerates hardware innovation and product commercialization. Its value proposition includes rapid prototyping and small batch flexible manufacturing, high-quality and high-reliability PCB products, advanced engineering and testing services, and digital transformation platforms that enhance customer R&D efficiency. The company’s proprietary EDA tools, extensive component libraries, and strong supply chain integration provide differentiated technical support and faster time-to-market for clients.
